en.headline: Golden Week day three passes 638,000 crossings by 4pm
en.dek: The Immigration Department said more than 190,000 of the inbound trips were by mainland visitors, mostly through Lok Ma Chau Spur Line.
body: More than 638,000 people crossed Hong Kong's control points on Saturday, the third day of the mainland National Day Golden Week, by 4pm, the Immigration Department told RTHK.

Nearly 322,000 trips were inbound, of which more than 190,000 were by mainland visitors. The busiest arrival point for those visitors was the Lok Ma Chau Spur Line control point, followed by the West Kowloon high-speed rail station. Outbound trips exceeded 316,000, about 240,000 of them by Hong Kong residents, most of them leaving through Lo Wu, then Lok Ma Chau Spur Line.

Separately, the culture, sports and tourism secretary, Rosanna Law, said on a television programme that about 277,000 mainland tourists arrived on the first day of the holiday, about 91 per cent of that day's inbound travellers, and that the figure was 17,000 above the 2018 day-one record. She said she still expected Hong Kong to meet a full-year target of 53.8 million visitor arrivals, while noting high airfares could weigh on short-haul travel.

zh.headline: 黃金周第三天截至下午4時逾63.8萬人次出入境
zh.dek: 入境處向港台表示，入境人次中超過19萬為內地旅客，最多經落馬洲支線管制站入境。
body: 入境處向港台表示，內地國慶黃金周第三天，截至周六下午4時，本港各管制站錄得超過63萬8千人次出入境。
入境近32萬2千人次，其中內地旅客超過19萬人次，最多經落馬洲支線管制站入境，其次是西九龍高鐵站。出境超過31萬6千人次，本港居民約佔24萬人次，最多經羅湖出境，其次是落馬洲支線管制站。
文化體育及旅遊局局長羅淑佩同日在電視節目表示，假期首日約有27萬7千名內地旅客來港，約佔當日入境旅客九成一，較2018年同日紀錄多約1萬7千人。她仍預期全年旅客可達5380萬人次的目標，但指機票價格高企或影響短途客來港意欲。
